snippet.title: Pokémon Dream Radar Trailer - Nintendo 3DS
snippet.description:
Look forward to the Pokémon Dream Radar game, a Nintendo 3DS exclusive title coming to the Nintendo eShop. Pokémon Dream Radar is a motion-controlled action game where, using Augmented Reality technology, you chase down Pokémon that appear as if they're in the real world! The game uses some of the coolest features of the Nintendo 3DS system, including the 3D camera and gyro sensor.

You can find many Pokémon in Pokémon Dream Radar, including Pokémon that are otherwise very hard to get. Then, you can send the Pokémon you obtain to your copy of Pokémon Black Version 2 or Pokémon White Version 2 for the Nintendo DS™ system, giving you even more ways to fill up your Pokédex!
